thread:
alex: quick q — thinking about adding "cohorted overrides" for runtime flags so we can route 10% to a cheaper model variant + change telemetry sampling for that cohort. wanted to capture UX + API + safety concerns before we spec. thoughts?

maya: love it. API shape idea: POST /configs/{key}/overrides { "cohort": "canary-10pct", "selector": "user_id % 100 < 10", "apply": {"model_variant":"redwood-lv2-quant"}, "telemetry_sampling": 0.2 }

ross: important: need audit + automatic drift detection. if model_variant changes upstream, override shouldn't silently fail. add schema field "pinned_model_version" + reconcile job.

priya: console UX: dropdown to pick target (route/org/segment), preview who'd be in cohort (example CSV sample), show expected qps and cost delta, and a "simulate" toggle that runs dry-run for 24h.

ops-bot: note: quota impact: overrides can increase per-token cost -> add soft guard that refuses override if predicted cost delta > 20% for last 24h unless override reason flagged as "emergency". Proposed guard snippet:
```json
{
  "cohort": "canary-10pct",
  "selector": "hash(user_id) % 100 < 10",
  "guards": {"max_cost_increase_pct": 20}
}
```

maya: telemetry sampling concern: reduced sampling for cohort will hide regressions. better: keep full eval hooks for quality checks but downsample non-eval telemetry. propose fields: "telemetry_sampling": {"cost_metrics":0.1, "quality_eval":1.0}

alex: +1 on eval hooks. also need API for temporary TTL: "override_ttl_seconds". default 72h with auto-expire + audit log entry.

ross: operationally: add rollout steps: ["dry-run", "cohort-apply", "escalate-if-diff>threshold", "auto-promote-or-revert"]. tie to alerts (quality_regression, latency_delta).

priya: question: who owns lifecycle? config or product? my take: platform owns primitives (API/guard/telemetry), product owns cohorts + rollout policy per feature.

alex: assigning follow-up: i'll write RFC draft. owner: alex, reviewer: ross, prs for API + console. target: end of next week. @maya can you sketch console wireframes?

maya: on it. I'll drop links later. :thumbsup:

config-bot: created RFC rfc/cohorted-overrides-2026-03-19 (https://go/repo/rfc/cohorted-overrides-2026-03-19)

(ended)
